source: User-supplied Mossguard_Design_and_Assets.zip, cropped level-concepts-01 panels retained beside restorations.
method: Imagegen referenced-image edits; each source was visually inspected before generation. Requested faithful higher-resolution material detail, original complete bounds, exact composition/landmarks, original palette, no text/UI/numbers/units.
limitations: Generative restoration adds new fine detail. It cannot recover unavailable original high-resolution pixels. Gameplay landmarks were visually checked; source crops remain tracked for comparison.

assets.encoding: Lossless WebP; RGB pixels verified identical to the generated restoration; no crop or rescale.
assets.displayAspect: Use original source aspect ratio; generated raster differs by less than 0.2%.
assets.review: All original road routes, round site counts, bridges, portal and gate layout retained. Generated detail is a faithful reinterpretation, not recovered original high-resolution pixels. Landmark centers visually within approximately 1% of source normalized positions.
